name: Piyale Pasha Mosque
scope: Standing Piyale Pasha Mosque in Kasımpaşa, with six matching lead-covered domes in two rows, a central north minaret, double gallery system and the octagonal historic türbe.
era: Standing mosque and türbe, with section controls from Gurlitt’s 1912 survey

publicDomainEvidence.sourceCitation: Gurlitt, C. (1912), ''Die Baukunst Konstantinopels'', Berlin: E. Wasmuth. A cropped and edited version of the scanned figure downloaded from [http://dome.mit.edu/handle/1721.3/65885 MIT libraries' Dome]

originalReview.notes: Exact fully sized 1912 plan and two measured sections. The matching original MIT Libraries print supports the 2 × 3 dome matrix, double galleries, buttress projection, north minaret profile and roof elevation.

review.method: Exact Qualla original with primary publication and explicit archive public-domain status.
review.notes: Started with the exact Qualla Gurlitt historical plate, matched to the publisher’s original plate preserved by MIT Libraries. A CC0 museum tile detail depicts a different type of subject and is outside this exterior model. Modern share-alike architectural photos were excluded.
